lesson.title: Mastering Antifragility
lesson.topic: Practical strategies to enhance personal resilience and thrive in challenging environments through antifragile principles.
lesson.steelman: How can one apply the concept of hormesis (stress-induced growth) across various aspects of life, such as health, finance, and mental well-being?
lesson.example: Implementing intermittent fasting and cold showers to improve physical resilience and adaptability.

rationale: Expanding the understanding of antifragility beyond theory to actionable practices for personal growth.
